reason: The pure outside-in protocol-first approach risks over-designing the IPC schema before any async runtime code reveals what the protocol actually needs to carry. Locking types before the first real Tokio task topology is proven can produce painful breaking changes. The synthesis captures the fake-first insight without the premature freeze risk.
